About Test My Food Sensitivity
Test My Food Sensitivity offers At-home Hair Sensitivity Tests designed to help customers discover potential food and environmental sensitivities. Bioresonance looks at energetic frequencies from a hair sample to identify potential sensitivity patterns. It does not measure immune antibodies or provide a medical diagnosis.

What customers receive
Customers follow the instructions for the selected product, provide the requested hair sample and receive personalised results showing potential sensitivity patterns. Results are provided in 5-7 working days once the sample is received; postal time is separate. Hair sensitivity tests include a 30-day money-back guarantee subject to the linked policy. Over one million tests have been sold across our family of brands since 2008. Samples are processed by our experienced testing team using an established process and internal quality checks.

Affiliate offer
Approved affiliates earn 10% commission on qualifying net product sales. Customers receive 10% off eligible products through the approved affiliate link or code, with no discount stacking. The tracking cookie is 30 days and referrals are reviewed for 30 days before monthly payment of approved commission.

Who we want to work with
We welcome responsible nutrition and food educators, original-content wellness publishers, relevant newsletters and podcasters, and carefully selected creators or existing customers with a genuine audience fit. Suitable content includes explaining the at-home process, what customers receive, and what potential sensitivity patterns can and cannot mean.

Promotion requirements
Affiliates must use the current TMFS Claims Library, include a clear affiliate disclosure, and must not present the service as an allergy test, clinical diagnosis, treatment or cure. Brand bidding, misleading medical claims, public coupon posting, cashback, browser extensions, adware, spam and undisclosed sub-affiliate activity are prohibited unless TMFS gives specific written approval. Applications are reviewed before activation. Questions: info@testmyfoodsensitivity.com.
payout_period: Commissions are paid 30 days after the sale is completed and verified, allowing time for refund and chargeback processing.

Test My Food Sensitivity — Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to Test My Food Sensitivity! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant ("we" or "merchant") and an affiliate ("you" or "affiliate") who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorised to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else's referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you're not assigned a branded coupon, then you're not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

Affiliates must not impersonate Test My Food Sensitivity in any form, including creating fake brand accounts, running paid advertisements that appear to originate from Test My Food Sensitivity, or bidding on Test My Food Sensitivity brand terms in paid search. Affiliates promoting through Meta platforms (Facebook, Instagram) should be aware that health and wellness products are subject to Meta's sensitive category advertising policies, which may restrict campaign delivery or require special ad account authorisation. Test My Food Sensitivity accepts no liability for affiliate campaigns restricted or rejected by Meta or any other advertising platform. Any affiliate found to be in breach of platform advertising policies while promoting Test My Food Sensitivity may be removed from the programme without notice.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission is displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

The tracking cookie lasts 30 days from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate's link or uses the coupon. Within this period, every order made by this customer at the merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (there is no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link again).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@testmyfoodsensitivity.com

8. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates must not engage in fraudulent activities, spam, or misrepresent our products or services. This includes making medical or diagnostic claims about Test My Food Sensitivity products that are not supported by our official marketing materials.

Sensitive Traffic Sources Policy:

Affiliates must not promote products through the following sensitive traffic sources without prior written approval:

  • Adult content websites or platforms
  • Illegal content or file-sharing sites
  • Sites promoting violence, hate speech, or discrimination
  • Gambling or betting platforms
  • Cryptocurrency or high-risk investment promotions

Any affiliate found to be in breach of this policy may be removed from the programme immediately and without notice.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document. We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@testmyfoodsensitivity.com for support.
